subject: Follow-up on your FlexiFunnels support call – coupon code at checkout
body_text:
Hi Meera,

Thank you for speaking with us. You came to us because your SAVE20 coupon code showed "Invalid coupon" at checkout for the Advanced Course.

What we completed during the call:
- You added the Advanced Course to the SAVE20 coupon, which had been assigned only to the Starter Course, and saved it.
- You applied the code at checkout and confirmed the 20 percent discount now shows.

What we discussed:
- The coupon expires on the 15th. If you want to extend it, you can change the expiry date on the same coupon page; this is entirely up to you.

You can rewatch our call here: https://fathom.video/share/EXAMPLE-F1

If anything is unclear, just reply to this email.

Warm regards,
Riya
FlexiFunnels Support
